verdict.rationale: AFK's own docs say tasks run "on autopilot" and that the AI carries goal-driven processes forward, with reads running automatically and blocked steps resuming on their own. That is real autonomous execution, but writes pause for sign-off by default, and every claim comes from vendor marketing. Missing for 10: documented recurring schedules or event triggers for user-defined background automations, evidence of fully unattended write actions, independent or hands-on corroboration, and in-depth docs on how to configure automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Every task — incorporation, banking, payroll, cap table — runs in the same workspace, on autopilot.
Reads run automatically. Writes pause for sign-off. Cost-incurring actions show estimates. You control the boundary between autonomous and supervised.
Blocked nodes resume automatically when dependencies clear.
It carries the process forward and asks when it needs a human decision.
